response.sql: WITH per AS (SELECT a.account_id, d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS n_orders FROM "order" o JOIN account a ON a.account_id = o.account_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY a.account_id, d.A3) SELECT account_id, region, n_orders, n_orders - (SELECT AVG(n_orders * 1.0) FROM per) AS diff_from_avg FROM per ORDER BY diff_from_avg DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The average is the mean number of orders per account, computed over accounts that have at least one order (after the joins, which do not drop any orders given the foreign keys).
Ties at 10th place are broken arbitrarily by LIMIT 10, as the request allows.
